title: RADIO FM-ANTENNA
summary: U69 AM/FM radio antenna (fender-mount mast antenna on the rear fender, above the frame kick-up): the antenna body comes up from under the fender through a ground plate and reinforcement and is clamped on top by the bezel and cap nut; the rod & mast screws into it. A ground strap runs from the antenna reinforcement to the frame, and the antenna lead-in cable (sheet B2) plugs into the bottom of the antenna body. A shipping cap protects the body until the mast is installed.

fastening.note: Body [7] goes up from under the fender through reinforcement [6], ground plate [5] and the 15/16 dia hole in the fender; gasket [4] and bezel [3] sit on top and cap [2] threads onto the body to clamp the stack. The body's rib engages the 1/8 dia locating hole (RIB OF BEZEL). The threads are on the antenna body itself; there is no separate stud.
Rivet [11] fastens reinforcement [6] to ground plate [5]; ground plate has holes at its corners for rivets to the fender (exact count of rivets not stated).
Screw [8] with lock washer [10] holds one end of ground strap [9] to the tab on reinforcement [6].
Other end of ground strap [9] goes to the frame side rail with the production screw, ground wire and lock washer (PROD SCREW, GROUND WIRE & L. WASHER); lock washer [10] shown there.
Sealer 55c at the cable plug where it enters the bottom of body [7].
Rod & mast [14] screws into the top of body [7] after shipping cap [1] is removed (Note B).

notes: NOTE: Shipping cap must be installed before exposure to water testing or weather.
NOTE: Install this end of cable from inside passenger compartment. Pull thru hole in underbody panel until grommet on cable is secured in hole. Route cable over ground strap & attach to antenna.
